mentions.name: MadHatter
mentions.description: A web tool for designing knitting and crochet patterns. It features a continuous canvas that wraps around like a 3D hat, automatic decreases to shape hats, overstitching markers for multi-color rows, parameterized designs (waves, trees, geometric shapes) with click-and-drag positioning, color palette merging, repeat previews, and PDF export for printing or tablet use. It works best on desktop.
mentions.problem: Yarncrafters painstakingly build spreadsheets or try to bend existing general-purpose pixel editors to their will, which is time consuming and frustrating.
mentions.audience: Yarncrafters (knitters and crocheters) who currently rely on spreadsheets or general-purpose pixel editors
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been plugging away on MadHatter (https://madhatter.app), a web tool for knitting/crochet projects. It works best on desktop!
